workflow.name: OLEANDER Blender Professional FreeCAD Oblique Face Translate

authority_chain.selector: SELECTOR::LOCAL_POS_X_FACE resolved from yaw-transformed world normal
authority_chain.kernel_route: TopoShape.replaceShape / BRepTools_ReShape with sew/fix normalization and shell-to-solid rebuild when required

bounded_scope: R001 rectangular prism 80x50x10 mm yawed +30 degrees about world Z
R002 rectangular prism 100x60x12 mm yawed -25 degrees about world Z
semantic local +X planar face re-resolved from its transformed world normal after both dimension and yaw changes
selected face world normal is explicitly not aligned to world X/Y/Z
selected face translates 5 mm strictly within its own tangent plane
target plus four adjacent faces are replaced through BRepTools_ReShape while opposite face is not replaced
R001 and R002 preserve valid one-solid six-face B-Rep topology and source volume
opposite face center and area remain unchanged
zero translation, translation with selected-face normal component, >20 mm translation and selector miss all fail before accepted mutation
FCStd plus R001/R002 STEP artifacts persist with selector/yaw/translation authority metadata
Blender creates two tessellated display-only derivatives and preserves source hash/selector/yaw/translation/authority across .blend save/reopen
invalidation_rule: Invalidate this bounded validation if the semantic local-face selector is replaced by raw FaceN persistence, the selected face becomes world-axis-only, the tangent-plane/failure gates are removed, source geometry authority moves to mesh-only mutation, or source authority no longer survives Blender readback.
authority_note: This receipt proves a bounded yaw-oblique planar tangential face translation workflow. It does not prove arbitrary 3D orientation, nonplanar editing or P0-B PASS.
